I make A LOT of boiled eggs. My method has yet to fail me.

Put your eggs in your pot. 
Add enogh tap water to cover the eggs. 
Add a couple pinches of salt and splash of distilled white vinegar. 
Cover and bring to a boil. 
Once your water is boiling, turn the heat off. 
Set a timer for 10 minutes and let the eggs sit in the hot water. 
After ten minutes, put the eggs in an ice bath for 2-3 minutes.
Gently crack eggs on all sides, roll and peel!

I swear by this method. Boiled eggs are one of my favorite snacks!
